description: Workplan-0b/M_N exploration: Tasks 1 (C2 inflection structural), 2 (Route B Frobenius trace), 3 (Route C Bring zero-mode sketch). Documents what's known + open R&D direction for upgrading the M_N anchor from CLASS-A to derived per the framework's three-calibration-discipline.

task_3_route_c_sketch.status: Sketch only; concrete computation deferred to follow-up R&D

data.recommendation: Pursue Route B with the operator-valued LR framework from PR #689 lineage. Simple Vol(K_p) ansätze (Route A) are ruled out by PR #701's R&D 4. The C2 inflection (PR #690) lacks structural derivation. Bring zero-mode adaptation (Route C) needs concrete characteristic-class identification before numerical compute is meaningful.

caveats: Exploratory probe — no production wiring. Surfaces the structural open pieces for each of the three Workplan-0b/M_N routes. Concrete compute on Routes B and C is deferred to dedicated follow-up R&D.
